definitions.explanation: The fundamental or essential part of something.

examples.japanese: {基本|きほん}{的|てき}な{知識|ちしき}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
{料理|りょうり}の{基本|きほん}を{教|おし}える。
examples.english: To teach the basics of cooking.

notes:
{基本|きほん} refers to the fundamental elements or essentials of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {基本|きほん}を{学|まな}ぶ: to learn the basics
- {基本|きほん}を{押|お}さえる: to grasp the fundamentals
- {基本|きほん}{的|てき}な〜: basic ~
- {基本|きほん}から{始|はじ}める: to start from the basics
- {基本|きほん}に{立|た}ち{返|かえ}る: to go back to basics

COMPOUNDS:
- {基本|きほん}{給|きゅう}: base salary
- {基本|きほん}{料金|りょうきん}: basic fee
- {基本|きほん}{方針|ほうしん}: basic policy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {基礎|きそ}: foundation (often interchangeable, but {基礎|きそ} emphasizes underlying structure)
- {土台|どだい}: base, foundation (more physical/concrete)
